abilities.name: Grinderfist Tunnellers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the tunnels below** and includes any models armed with **Grinderfists**.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Shock Gauntlets
abilities.effect: Each time an attack made with this unit's **Shock Gauntlets** scores a critical hit, that attack scores D6 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpfire Braziers** is 4.

abilities.name: Staff of the Horned Rat
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Warp-amulet
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Boneripper Rampage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3-5, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Terrible Madness
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn. In addition, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: The Thirteen-headed One
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per battle.
***Master of Dire Sorcery:*** Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Masterclan Wizards^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
***Commander of Vermin:*** Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Verminus^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
***Knower of Warp-tech:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **^^Skryre^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
***Deliverer of Weeping Blades:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Eshin^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
***Bringer of Plagues:*** Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly **^^Pestilens Priests^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
***Shaper of Fleshcraft:*** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Terrifying Monstrosity
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
• Subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: The Dreaded Thirteenth Spell
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Roll 13 dice. For each 5+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• You can return 1 slain model to a friendly **Clanrats** unit wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Lord of Assassins
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly **^^Eshin Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Burst From the Shadows
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can pick a point on the battlefield within 13" of this unit and within 1" of any enemy units. Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point.
**Designer's Note:** *This ability allows the unit to set up in combat with a new enemy unit.*

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

abilities.name: Altar of the Horned Rat
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Peal of Doom
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:
**1 *Magical Backlash:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
**2-4 *Wall of Unholy Sound:*** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.
**5-6 *Apocalyptic Doom:*** Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 13" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Cracks Call
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that does not have **^^Fly^^** and is within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the casting roll exceeds the target's **^^Move^^** characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the casting roll and its **^^Move^^** characteristic.

units.name: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell (Scourge of Aqshy)

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

abilities.name: The Bell Tolls
abilities.effect: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Skaven^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Echoes of the Vermindoom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **^^Skaven^^** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.

abilities.name: Pealing Portal
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly **Gnawhole** for the purposes of the 'Gnawhole Ambush', 'Tunnels Through Reality' and 'The Endless Vermintide' abilities.

abilities.name: Tyrant of Battle
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Verminus Infantry^^** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The targets can each use the 'All-out Attack' or 'All-out Defence' command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.

abilities.name: Killing Blow
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a damaged enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of damage points the target has, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Divine the Future
abilities.effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, add 2" to the distance friendly units can move when using the 'Always Three Clawsteps Ahead' ability.

abilities.name: Arch-Manipulator
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Hurl Scry-orb
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: This unit cannot use the 'Divine the Future' ability for the rest of the battle. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Tectonic Splintering
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Cornered Rat
abilities.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Blade**.

abilities.name: Gnash-gnaw on Their Bones!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Verminus Infantry^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: More-more Warp Energy!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Warplock Musket** to 3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

abilities.name: Sniper-master
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit and friendly **Warplock Jezzails** units wholly within 13" of this unit can ignore the effects of the 'Guarded Hero' ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking the target for their shooting attacks.

abilities.name: More-more Doom!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of its **Doomrocket** to D3+3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

abilities.name: Explosive Payload
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

abilities.name: Bubonic Barrage
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. If the result is equal to or less than the number of models in that enemy unit that were slain by attacks made by this unit's **Plagueclaw Catapult** this phase, that enemy unit has **^^Strike‑last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Warpstone Snipers
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Warplock Jezzails** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: More-more Warpstone Bullets!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **^^Skryre Hero^^**, this unit's **Hail of Warpstone Bullets** has an Attacks characteristic of 6D6+3 instead of 3D6+3 for the rest of the turn. However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit's **Hail of Warpstone Bullets**, inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit after the **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Fire
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

abilities.name: Unleashed Warp-fury
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Whirling Doom
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Overseers of the Enginecovens
abilities.effect: If a friendly **^^Skryre^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit uses the 'Covering Fire' command, no command points are spent.

abilities.name: Rolling Doom
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to its **^^Move^^** characteristic. This unit can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.
Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
**Designer's Note:** *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*

abilities.name: Lord of Great Plagues
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If the unmodified chanting roll for a friendly **^^Pestilens Priest^^** this phase was 6, pick 1 of the following effects to apply:
***Crimsonweal Curse:*** Pick an enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the battle, each time the target uses a **^^Move^^** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on it after the **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.
***The Neverplague:*** For the rest of the battle, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly **^^Pestilens Priests^^**.
***Undulant Scourge:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Plaguemaster
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Give this unit 1 ritual point.

abilities.name: Foetid Features
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:
***Noisome Halitosis:*** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Plague Breath**.
***Pestilential Seepage:*** While this unit is damaged, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly **^^Pestilens Priests^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
***Curdled Miasma:*** While they are within 6" of this unit, enemy units are not visible to other enemy units more than 3" from them.

abilities.name: Seething Blight
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
• If the target is replaced and the replacement unit has 1 model, allocate damage points to that replacement unit equal to half X (rounding up), where X is its Health characteristic minus the number of damage points allocated to it (if any).
• If the target is replaced and the replacement unit has more than 1 model, half the models in that replacement unit (rounding up) are automatically slain.

abilities.name: Gas Clouds
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Poisoned Wind Globes** for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnashing Teeth and Flailing Fists** is 8.

abilities.name: Avalanche of Flesh
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
abilities.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

abilities.name: Too Horrible to Die
abilities.effect:
The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:
**1 *Dead:*** This unit is destroyed.
**2-4 *The Rats Emerge:*** Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Then, this unit is destroyed.
**5-6 *It's Alive!:*** This unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.

abilities.name: Spreaders of Filth and Disease
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Seething Swarm
abilities.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

abilities.name: Elite Bodyguard
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Skaven Infantry Heroes^^** have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Warpstone Shards
abilities.effect:
The next time you make a casting roll for this unit this phase, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6. This roll cannot be rerolled or modified.
If the casting roll is 13, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound. After the effect of that spell has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
If the casting roll is not 13, remove 1 dice of your choice from the casting roll and use the remaining 2D6 as the casting roll.

abilities.name: Shadowy Killers
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Running Death
abilities.effect: While friendly **^^Eshin^^** units are wholly within 13" of this unit, they can use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Lord of Flesh-grafting
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: **Heal (3)** the target.

abilities.name: Tyrannical Packmaster
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Cornered Rat
abilities.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Halberd**.

abilities.name: Cruel Commander
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Verminus Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 5 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Plague Censer** is 2.

abilities.name: Corrupting Influence
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Altar of the Great Corruptor
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Pestilens^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: More-more Warp Lightning!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **^^Skryre Hero^^**, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Warp Lightning Blast** for the rest of the turn.
However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit's **Warp Lightning Blast**, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit after the **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Warp Lightning Blast
abilities.effect: Each attack made with this weapon in a single phase must target the same enemy unit. Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Grappling Hooks
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit was not set up this turn, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Smoke Bombs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit's attacks.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: Warpstone Fumes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Regenerating Terror
abilities.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

abilities.name: Foster Competition
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **Stormvermin** units while they are wholly within 13"of this unit.

abilities.name: Doomfang
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn but it cannot use commands this phase.

abilities.name: A Reputation For Cunning
abilities.effect: You can pick 2 different eligible units to use the 'Always Three Clawsteps Ahead' ability this phase instead of 1, but at least 1 of those units must have the **^^Verminus^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Plague Rat
abilities.effect: This unit's **Plague rat** is a token. If you make an unmodified chanting roll of 1 for this unit while its **Plague rat** is on the battlefield, you can remove its **Plague rat** from the battlefield and then re-roll that chanting roll.

abilities.name: Enshrouding Fumes
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

units.name: Vizzik Skour, Prophet of the Horned Rat

abilities.name: Fissures In Reality
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Prophet of the Horned Rat
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can re-roll chanting rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn

abilities.name: Gaze of the Gnaw
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:
• If this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: The Death Frenzy
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13"of this unit or a visible friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
If the target is a friendly unit, it can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: More-more Warpvolt Doom!
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's **Warpvolt Obliterator** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each other enemy unit within the target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Lightning Master
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Warpvolt Scourgers** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Warpvolt Scourgers** to 10 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Tunnel Skulkers
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly non-**^^Monster Skaven^^** unit if those units have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve **in the tunnels below**. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Warp-ambush
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if this unit is **in the tunnels below**.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and pick one of the following effects.
• On a 4+, pick an enemy unit that is more than 6" from all other enemy units. You can set up this unit on the battlefield in combat with that enemy unit and not in combat with any other enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up **in the tunnels below** with the 'Tunnel Skulkers' ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit, in combat with that enemy unit, and not in combat with any other enemy units.
• You can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up **in the tunnels below** with the 'Tunnel Skulkers' ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bomb Rats
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: This unit's **Bomb Rats** are tokens. If there are fewer than 2 friendly **Bomb Rats** next to enemy units, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit that does not have a friendly **Bomb Rat** next to it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place this unit's **Bomb Rat** next to the target.

abilities.name: Detonate
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick each enemy unit that has a friendly **Bomb Rat** token to be a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within a target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. Then, remove the target's **Bomb Rat**.

abilities.name: Master of Assassins
abilities.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy **^^Hero^^**.

abilities.name: Shadowblood Cloak
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Eshin^^** unit that has 2 or more models and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the target. This unit can be set up in combat.

abilities.name: Diversionary Assault
abilities.declare:
Pick a visible friendly **Gutter Runners** unit wholly within
13" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Too Quick to Hit-hit
abilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: The Lurking Vermintide
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the tunnels below**. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly **Gnawholes** on the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gnawhole** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

abilities.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Monster Skaven^^** unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Gnawhole Ambush
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit that is **in the tunnels below** to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Skitterleap
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Hero^^** wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Warpgale
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Warpstone Charm
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Skavenbrew
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Foulhide
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Skryre Prototypes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Skryre^^** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
**1 *Kaboom!:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
**2-5 *More Power!:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
**6 *More-more Power!:*** In addition to the effect of 'More Power!', add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Prized Creations
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**^^Hero Moulder^^** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
**1-2 *Self-destructive Fury:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
**3-4 *Rabid Infusion:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
**5-6 *Blinded by Frenzy:*** In addition to the effect of 'Rabid Infusion', the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Corrupted Earth
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Pestilens^^** units that are in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Claw-picked
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Verminus^^** units that charged this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scurry-flee!
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Eshin^^** units.

abilities.name: Masterclan Connections
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** or **^^Unbind^^** ability for a visible **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit
abilities.effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.

abilities.name: Master of the Swarm
abilities.effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

abilities.name: Essence of the Gnaw
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **^^Strike-first^^** and the target has **^^Strike-last^^**.

abilities.name: Short-tempered
abilities.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Scurry Away
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Skilled Manipulator
abilities.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Fleshmeddler
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Devious Underling
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Skaven Hero^^** on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit's Health characteristic to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target has not been slain, friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Pit Tinkerer
abilities.effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Skryre War Machines^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly **^^Skryre War Machine^^** wholly within 18" of this unit uses the 'Rolling Doom' or 'Whirling Doom' ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.

abilities.name: Summon Bell of Doom
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bell of Doom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Bell of Doom** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Vermintide
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.

abilities.name: Filth-crust
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Bile-torrent
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

abilities.name: Rabid-tough
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn

abilities.name: Transplanted Brains
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:
**Warpstone Addict's Brain:**
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
**Warlock Whelp's Brain:** Add 10 to this unit's control score.

abilities.name: Anabolic Accelerators
abilities.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

abilities.name: Serrated Bone Protrusions
abilities.effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.
